definition: Torch is an open-source machine learning library, a scientific computing framework, and a scripting language based on Lua.
details: It provides LuaJIT interfaces to deep learning algorithms implemented in C. It was created by the Idiap Research Institute. Torch development moved in 2017 to PyTorch, a port of the library to Python.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Torch (machine learning).
